errors.text_span: 在1950年达到约50，1954年达到峰值约65，之后急剧下降至1956年约10
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately states that the blue line reaches about 50 in 1950 and a peak of about 65 in 1954, which are higher than the actual values shown in the figure.
The x-axis has tick marks at every 2-year interval, not 4-year intervals.
The solid blue line does not have any markers according to the figure.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart related to changes in a specific measure of standard deviation.
The description fails to mention the presence of peaks and notable fluctuations in the data, especially during the 1960s-1980s.
The description fails to mention that the y-axis measures are in terms of standard deviation.
